description: We are We Love Code, a six-person, fully technical team. Jesús coordinates and supports; Leia handles the presentation and video; Santiago manages deployment; Salva leads web development; and Sergio and Noelia provide technical support. All of us are programmers: Leia and Noelia also bring audiovisual and communication skills; Salva and Jesús are professional real-time systems programmers; and Sergio programs in C++ and brings administrative experience.
